capability.description: Searches The Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection API with one required q parameter. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Museum collection discovery; not artwork authentication, valuation, image licensing, or art criticism.

constraint.io_signature: Input: q at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and The Met search result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one artwork, artist, culture, or collection search string
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: no department, date, geography, medium, pagination, or object-detail input
wrapper does not locally truncate or parse object IDs
search coverage and current collection data are external; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing The Met search count/object IDs, URL, and HTTP status.

negative_intents: authenticate an artwork or estimate its value

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing The Met search count/object IDs, URL, and HTTP status.
